solo_draft.title: Vince Carter Jumps Over 7'2" Frédéric Weis for the Poster Dunk | 2000 Sydney Olympics
solo_draft.description:
Vince Carter jumps over 7'2" Frédéric Weis and throws down the slam at the 2000 Sydney Olympics.

The jump over Frédéric Weis is the defining detail: Vince Carter gets above the defender before finishing at the rim, making this far more specific than a standard poster dunk.
